title: Source Docs Subgroup Gates
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the agent-and-skill-design Work path, owner repository, active role, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
The source-docs umbrella no longer runs every source-docs unit test file.
A source-docs unit test file is assigned to zero or more than one focused source-docs subgroup.
The source-docs subgroup split removes the records, source-docs, app, build, or e2e coverage from the default Project Control check gate.
This phase is treated as proof of Core, Backend, Editor, product behavior, readiness, release status, or product-repository test strategy.
verificationTarget: Project Control exposes focused source-docs subgroup scripts for source-docs:core-migration, source-docs:live-draft, source-docs:template-builder, source-docs:text-block, and source-docs:text-engine; keeps source-docs as an umbrella group; keeps test:unit and check on their full grouped gates; and verifies each subgroup plus source-docs umbrella before records are accepted.
summary: Done: split the Project Control source-docs group into semantic source-docs subgroups so PLAN and WORK lanes can run focused source-document checks without paying the whole source-docs gate unless the lane crosses subgroup boundaries.
